Hz_Titre: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3, rewritten in Rust
Hz_Texte: Horizon is a free, open-source reimplementation of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 in Rust: same worlds and rules, more frames per second and faster loading. Misty downloads its builds straight from GitHub (keep as many as you like), prepares them once from Minecraft 26.3 and starts them: no other launcher needed. A Microsoft account that owns the game is required, and Java mods (Fabric, Forge…) don't run in Horizon.
